arxiv-1911-03007.title: Effect of strain on magnetic and orbital ordering of LaSrCrO 3 /LaSrMnO 3 heterostructures
arxiv-1911-03007.creator: Sanaz Koohfar, Alexandru B. Georgescu, Ingrid Hallsteinsen, Ritesh Sachan, Manuel A. Roldan, Elke Arenholz, Divine P. Kumah
arxiv-1911-03007.description: Abstract We investigate the effect of strain and film thickness on the orbital and magnetic properties of LaSrCrO 3 (LSCO)/LaSrMnO 3 (LSMO) heterostructures using bulk magnetometry, soft X-ray magnetic spectroscopy, first-principles density functional theory, high-resolution electron microscopy and X-ray diffraction.

arxiv-2211-13934.title: Spectral Invariance of Quasi-Banach Algebras of Matrices and Pseudodifferential Operators
arxiv-2211-13934.creator: Karlheinz Gröchenig, Christine Pfeuffer, Joachim Toft
arxiv-2211-13934.description: Abstract . We extend the stability and spectral invariance of convolution-dominated matrices to the case of quasi-Banach algebras p < 1 p<1 . As an application we construct a spectrally invariant quasi-Banach algebra of pseudodifferential operators with non-smooth symbols that generalize Sjöstrand’s results. 2010 Mathematics Subject Classification 35P05, 35S05, 47G30 1.

arxiv-2301-05896.title: Geometric embedding for regularity structures
arxiv-2301-05896.creator: Yvain Bruned 1, Foivos Katsetsiadis
arxiv-2301-05896.description: Abstract In this paper, we show how one can view certain models in regularity structures as some form of geometric rough paths. This is performed by identifying the deformed Butcher-Connes-Kreimer Hopf algebra with a quotient of the shuffle Hopf algebra which is the structure underlying the definition of a geometric rough path.

arxiv-2305-19585.title: LAIT: Efficient Multi-Segment Encoding in Transformers with Layer-Adjustable Interaction
arxiv-2305-19585.creator: Jeremiah Milbauer, Annie Louis, Mohammad Javad Hosseini, Alex Fabrikant, Donald Metzler, Tal Schuster
arxiv-2305-19585.description: Abstract Transformer encoders contextualize token representations by attending to all other tokens at each layer, leading to quadratic increase in compute effort with the input length. In practice, however, the input text of many NLP tasks can be seen as a sequence of related segments (e.g., the sequence of sentences within a passage, or the hypothesis and premise in NLI).

arxiv-2308-12637.title: Minimal surfaces with symmetries
arxiv-2308-12637.creator: Franc Forstnerič
arxiv-2308-12637.description: Abstract Abstract Let G be a finite group acting on a connected open Riemann surface X by holomorphic automorphisms and acting on a Euclidean space \mathbb{R}^{n} (n\geq 3) by orthogonal transformations. We identify a necessary and sufficient condition for the existence of a G -equivariant conformal minimal immersion F:X\to\mathbb{R}^{n} .

arxiv-2502-00595.title: RPGBench : Evaluating Large Language Models as Role-Playing Game Engines
arxiv-2502-00595.creator: Pengfei Yu, Dongming Shen, Silin Meng, Jaewon Lee, Weisu Yin, Andrea Yaoyun Cui, Zhenlin Xu, Yi Zhu, Xingjian Shi, Mu Li, Alex Smola
arxiv-2502-00595.description: Abstract We present RPGBench , the first benchmark designed to evaluate large language models (LLMs) as text-based role-playing game (RPG) engines. RPGBench comprises two core tasks: Game Creation (GC) and Game Simulation (GS). In GC, an LLM must craft a valid and playable RPG world using a structured event-state representation, ensuring logical coherence and proper termination conditions.

arxiv-2502-03107.title: Investigating the Bouncing Barrier with Collision Simulations of Compressed Dust Aggregates
arxiv-2502-03107.creator: Haruto Oshiro, Misako Tatsuuma, Satoshi Okuzumi, Hidekazu Tanaka
arxiv-2502-03107.description: Abstract The collision outcomes of dust aggregates in protoplanetary disks dictate how planetesimals form. Experimental and numerical studies have suggested that bouncing collisions occurring at low impact velocities may limit aggregate growth in the disks, but the conditions under which bouncing occurs have yet to be fully understood.

arxiv-2507-02549.title: A Data-Driven Prescribed-Time Control Framework via Koopman Operator and Adaptive Backstepping* * Note: Sub-titles are not captured in Xplore and should not be used Thanks: This work was supported by… (Please insert your funding information here).
arxiv-2507-02549.creator: Yue Wu
arxiv-2507-02549.description: Abstract Achieving rapid and time-deterministic stabilization for complex systems characterized by strong nonlinearities and parametric uncertainties presents a significant challenge. Traditional model-based control relies on precise system models, whereas purely data-driven methods often lack formal stability guarantees, limiting their applicability in safety-critical systems. This paper proposes a novel control framework that synergistically integrates data-driven modeling with model-based control.

pmc-10476319.title: Cost-utility analysis of valsartan, enalapril, and candesartan in patients with heart failure in Iran
pmc-10476319.creator: Ramin Ravangard, Farideh Sadat Jalali, Marjan Hajahmadi, Abdosaleh Jafari
pmc-10476319.description: BackgroundToday, heart failure is one of the leading causes of death and disability in most developed and developing countries. By 2030, more than 23.3 million people are projected to die of cardiovascular diseases each year, and the prevalence of heart failure is expected to increase by 25%.

pmc-10596985.title: Transgender people in different European and Latin American countries: A cross cultural comparison in some relevant measures
pmc-10596985.creator: A Giami, J Barrientos, C Scandurra, P Valerio
pmc-10596985.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). BackgroundPrejudice against transgender & gender-diverse people persists & is associated with physical & mental health harm. This study describes & characterizes comparative data between countries on gender self-definition/expression & its relationship to gender incongruence diagnosis.MethodsWe used snowball sampling for a face-to-face survey in France (N = 379; 2010), Italy (N = 167; 2015-2016), Brazil (N = 391; 2016), & Chile (N = 377, 2018). Participants were 18+ years & identified as transgender.

pmc-10672810.title: Research of Multicopper Oxidase and Its Degradation of Histamine in Lactiplantibacillus plantarum LPZN19
pmc-10672810.creator: Huijie Pei, Yilun Wang, Wei He, Lin Deng, Qinjie Lan, Yue Zhang, Lamei Yang, Kaidi Hu, Jianlong Li, Aiping Liu, Xiaolin Ao, Hui Teng, Shuliang Liu, Likou Zou, Ran Li, Yong Yang
pmc-10672810.description: In order to explore the structural changes and products of histamine degradation by multicopper oxidase (MCO) in Lactiplantibacillus plantarum LPZN19, a 1500 bp MCO gene in L. plantarum LPZN19 was cloned, and the recombinant MCO was expressed in E. coli BL21 (DE3).

pmc-10863050.title: Disruption of the thyroid hormone system and patterns of altered thyroid hormones after gestational chemical exposures in rodents – a systematic review
pmc-10863050.creator: Isabel Forner-Piquer, Asma H. Baig, Andreas Kortenkamp
pmc-10863050.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). We present a comprehensive overview of changes in thyroxine (T4) and thyroid stimulating hormone (TSH) serum concentrations after pre-gestational, gestational and/or lactation exposures of rodents to various chemicals that affect the thyroid hormone system. We show that T4 and TSH changes consistent with the idealized view of the hypothalamic-pituitary-thyroid (HPT) feedback loop (T4 decrements accompanied by TSH increases) are observed with only a relatively small set of chemicals. Most substances affect concentrations of various thyroid hormones without increasing TSH.

pmc-11046564.title: Keeping abreast of change – learning from specialist practice
pmc-11046564.creator: Anton Emmanuel
pmc-11046564.description: crisis, the lecture is a reflection of the approach of ClinMed. A thread running through the original manuscripts in this edition is the management of common clinical presentations, where advances in specialist care have led to opportunities for enhanced care offered by the non-specialist colleagues seeing these patients.

pmc-11354715.title: Research Advancements in Salt Tolerance of Cucurbitaceae: From Salt Response to Molecular Mechanisms
pmc-11354715.creator: Cuiyun Chen, Wancong Yu, Xinrui Xu, Yiheng Wang, Bo Wang, Shiyong Xu, Qingkuo Lan, Yong Wang
pmc-11354715.description: Soil salinization severely limits the quality and productivity of economic crops, threatening global food security. Recent advancements have improved our understanding of how plants perceive, signal, and respond to salt stress. The discovery of the Salt Overly Sensitive (SOS) pathway has been crucial in revealing the molecular mechanisms behind plant salinity tolerance.

pmc-11617050.title: Comparative Assessment of Post-Fatigue Resistance of Mandibular First Molars Restored With Polyether Ether Ketone and Lithium Disilicate Endocrowns
pmc-11617050.creator: Mehrak Amjadi, Mohammad Raouf Safari, Ramin Dini Torkamani, Mohammadsepehr Kheiri Manjili, Davoud Jamshidi, Fatemeh Sobhan, Soolmaz Heidari
pmc-11617050.description: Background and Objectives: Contemporary dentistry focuses on more conservative treatment options such as endocrown restorations and application of dental materials with higher resemblance to tooth structure. Polyether ether ketone (PEEK) polymer is a material used for the fabrication of endocrowns.

pmc-11634794.title: Research on the effect of LAMP1 in the development and progression of ccRCC and its potential mechanism with LC3C-mediated autophagy
pmc-11634794.creator: Xiongbao Wang, Liang Fang, Lixiang Xiao, Guangxin Zhong, Minghao Han, Bingshen Wang, Juchao Ren, Yuanwei Zang
pmc-11634794.description: BackgroundLysomembrane-associated protein 1 (LAMP1), known to exhibit differential expression in various tumor types and play a crucial role in the development of tumors. Clear cell Renal Cell Carcinoma (ccRCC) is still the most common pathological type of renal carcinoma with poor prognosis. However, the expression of LAMP1 and its underlying molecular mechanism with ccRCC remain elusive.

pmc-11712230.title: Brain dynamics and personality: a preliminary study
pmc-11712230.creator: Francesco Ciaramella, Lorenzo Cipriano, Emahnuel Troisi Lopez, Arianna Polverino, Fabio Lucidi, Giuseppe Sorrentino, Laura Mandolesi, Pierpaolo Sorrentino
pmc-11712230.description: Personality can be considered a system characterized by complex dynamics that are extremely adaptive depending on continuous interactions with the environment and situations. The present preliminary study explores the dynamic interplay between brain flexibility and personality by taking the dynamic approach to personality into account, thereby drawing from Cloninger's psychobiological model.

pmc-12382153.title: Transitioning to cleaner solutions and moving away from precautionary energy stacking in Lesotho households
pmc-12382153.creator: Seroala Tsoeu-Ntokoane, Moeketsi Kali, Xavier Lemaire
pmc-12382153.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). The optimism that the world will be heading for 100% renewable energy has recently heightened within academia and policymakers. This paper interrogates the prevailing energy patterns in Lesotho, where households depend on multiple energy sources, combining renewables and non-renewables. While there is increased access to grid electricity and solar technologies, the data reveals a persistent reliance on biomass, paraffin, coal, and liquefied petroleum gas.

pmc-12656991.title: Spermatogonial Stem Cells in Domestic Animals: Current Insights and Future Directions with a Focus on Dogs
pmc-12656991.creator: Caterina Squillacioti, Nicola Mirabella, Mario Iasevoli, Simona Tafuri, Valeria Iervolino, Alessandra Pelagalli, Xueming Zhang
pmc-12656991.description: Simple SummaryOver the last few decades, researchers have focused on spermatogonial stem cell (SSC) technology for enhancing livestock reproduction. SSCs isolated from the testes possess a unique capacity for self-renewal or differentiation into functional germ cells and have significant potential for transplantation into testicular tissue.

pmc-12708726.title: Comparative outcomes of robot-assisted, laparoscopic, and open radical nephrectomy: A Taiwan population-based study
pmc-12708726.creator: Marcelo Chen, Yu-San Chien, Ching-Hu Chung, Jiun-Yi Li
pmc-12708726.description: ObjectiveRadical nephrectomy continues to be the established treatment for patients with large or locally advanced renal tumors. Although the use of robot-assisted techniques has grown substantially in recent years, their definitive advantages compared to traditional laparoscopic or open surgeries remain unclear.

pmc-13357222.title: Health literacy in patients with epilepsy: a narrative review of current status, influencing factors, and future directions
pmc-13357222.creator: Nan Wen, Rui Wang, Yueyue He, Qian Jiang, Jianyu Peng, Ling Feng
pmc-13357222.description: Epilepsy is a common chronic neurological disorder that imposes a significant burden on patients’ physical and mental health, and low health literacy is closely associated with poor medication adherence, increased seizure frequency, and reduced quality of life in patients with epilepsy.

pmc-13551378.title: Alkyl Glucosides in Rinse‐Off and Leave‐On Cosmetics Available on the Dutch Market
pmc-13551378.creator: Mounir Yaâkoubi, Norbertus A Ipenburg, Anton C de Groot, Thomas Rustemeyer

pmc-13558904.title: Structural Divergence Between the Moltbook AI‐Agent Network and Human Social Networks
pmc-13558904.creator: Wenpin Hou, Zhicheng Ji
pmc-13558904.description: Large populations of artificial intelligence (AI) agents are increasingly embedded in online environments, yet little is known about how their collective interaction patterns compare to human social systems. Here, we analyze the full interaction network of Moltbook, an agent‐native platform in which AI agents interact through posts and comments, and systematically compare its structure to well‐characterized human communication networks.
